podcast.body: This single, a "prison worksong collected by the Lomaxes," was released before the album "Animalisms." John Steele left the group after its release due to financial issues. "After their next single, Inside Looking Out, a prism works on collected by the Lomaxes, and the album Animalisms, John Steele left the group tired of not getting any money, and went to work in a shop."
